whatsappMessage:
Hi Sugarbloom Bakery Team,

I noticed your designer cake store has exceptional 4.8★ reviews with 380+ happy customers in Boring Road, but lacked a dedicated mobile ordering page for custom celebration inquiries.

Maine aapke bakery ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme direct WhatsApp cake booking, signature designer collection, aur flavor menu integrate kiya hai:

🔗 https://sugarbloom-bakery-demo.arclane.studio

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: "Hi Sugarbloom Bakery Team, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke business (Sugarbloom Bakery®️) ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with direct WhatsApp cake ordering and your signature designer cakes collection for Boring Road customers. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact cake menu, actual photos aur contact setup integrate karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough."
